entries.source: Some walk in shadow, alone, unloved, unwanted. What powers they wield may be mighty, but their names are forever cursed.
entries.target: 有些人行走于阴影之中，孤独、无人关爱、不被需要。他们掌握的力量或许强大，但他们的名字永远受到诅咒。

entries.source: Affliction can run to the soul, and hatred can fill one's entire being. Overcome someone else's hated curse to know its dreaded meaning.
entries.target: 痛苦可以深入灵魂，憎恨可以充斥整个身心。战胜他人身上那可憎的诅咒，方能领会其可怕的含义。

entries.source: Worse, any who approach the Cursed can be driven mad by their terrible aura.
entries.target: 更可怕的是，任何接近被诅咒者的人，都可能受其可怕光环的影响而发狂。

entries.source: They can channel the power of the Sun to smite all who seek to destroy the Sunwall.
entries.target: 他们能引导太阳之力，痛击一切试图摧毁太阳堡垒的人。

entries.source: They can channel the power of the Sun and the Moons to burn and tear apart all who seek to destroy the Sunwall.
entries.target: 他们能引导太阳与月亮之力，灼烧并撕裂一切试图摧毁太阳堡垒的人。

entries.source: Masters of Sun and Moon magic, they usually burn their foes with Sun rays before calling the fury of the stars.
entries.target: 他们是日月魔法的大师，通常先用太阳射线灼烧敌人，再召唤群星之怒。

entries.source: Chronomancer
entries.target: 时空系

entries.source: Some do not walk upon the straight road others follow. Seek the hidden paths outside the normal course of life.
entries.target: 有些人并不走他人遵循的坦途。去寻觅常规生命轨迹之外的那些隐秘路径。

entries.source: Exploiting a hole in the fabric of spacetime, Chronomancers learn to pull threads from other timelines into their own.
entries.target: 通过利用时空结构上的孔洞，时空法师学会了将其他时间线的丝线拉入自己的时间线。

entries.source: Pulling these threads creates tension and the harder they pull the more tension is produced.
entries.target: 这些穿梭时空的行为会在时空中留下张力，他们改变现实的程度越大，造成的张力就越大。

entries.source: Constantly they manage this tension, which they call Paradox, to avoid or control the anomalies they inevitably unleash on the world around them.
entries.target: 他们时刻维系着这种被他们称为紊乱值的张力，以避免或控制其不可避免地在周围世界引发的异常现象。

entries.source: Paradox Mage
entries.target: 时空法师

entries.source: A hand may clap alone if it returns to clap itself. Search for the power in the paradox.
entries.target: 如果一只手能拍到过去的自己，那么就可以单手鼓掌。在时空悖论中寻求力量吧。

entries.source: A Paradox Mage studies the very fabric of spacetime, learning not just to bend it but shape it and remake it.
entries.target: 时空法师研究时空的结构本身，不仅要学会扭曲它，还要塑造它、重塑它。

entries.source: Most Paradox Mages lack basic skills that others take for granted (like general fighting sense), but they make up for it through control of cosmic forces.
entries.target: 大多数时空法师缺乏他人习以为常的基本技能（如基本的战斗意识），但他们能通过掌控宇宙力量来弥补。

entries.source: Paradox Mages start off with knowledge of all but the most complex Chronomantic schools.
entries.target: 时空法师开局便通晓除最复杂的时空学派之外的所有时空学派。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Magic and Willpower
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：魔力和意志。

entries.source: Temporal Warden
entries.target: 时空守卫

entries.source: We preserve the past to protect the future. The hands of time are guarded by the arms of war.
entries.target: 我们守护过去，以护佑未来。时间之手由战争之臂守卫。

entries.source: Their lifelines braided, Temporal Wardens have learned to work with their other selves across multiple timelines.
entries.target: 通过缠结不同的时间线，时空守卫可以召唤其他世界线的分身，和自己一同战斗。

entries.source: Through their study of chronomancy, they learn to blend archery and dual-weapon fighting, seamlessly switching from one to the other.
entries.target: 时空守卫通过学习时空法术，可以将箭术和双持武器战斗联合在一起，在两者之间随意切换。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Magic, Dexterity, and Willpower
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：魔力、敏捷和意志。

entries.source: Defiler
entries.target: 堕落系

entries.source: Dark thoughts, black bloods, vile deeds... Those who spill their brethren's blood will find its power.
entries.target: 黑暗的思想、黑色的血液、卑鄙的行为……那些倾洒同族之血的人，将发现血的力量。

entries.source: Defilers are touched by the mark of evil. They are a blight on the world. Working to promote the cause of evil, they serve their masters, or themselves become masters.
entries.target: 堕落系职业身上带有邪恶的印记，他们是世界的祸害。他们为邪恶事业效力，侍奉他们的主人，或者自己成为主人。

entries.source: Reaver
entries.target: 收割者

entries.source: Reap thee the souls of thine enemies, and the powers of darkness shall enter thy flesh.
entries.target: 收割敌人的灵魂，你会发现黑暗的力量涌入体内。

entries.source: Reavers are terrible foes, charging their enemies with a weapon in each hand.
entries.target: 收割者是可怕的对手，他们双手各持一把武器向敌人发起冲锋。

entries.source: They can harness the blight of evil, infecting their foes with terrible contagious diseases while crushing their skulls with devastating combat techniques.
entries.target: 他们可以驾驭邪恶的枯萎术，一边将恐怖的传染病散布给敌人，一边以毁灭性的战斗技巧击碎他们的头颅。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Magic
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和魔力。

entries.source: Corruptor
entries.target: 腐化者

entries.source: Blight and depravity hold the greatest powers. Accept temptation and become one with corruption.
entries.target: 枯萎与堕落蕴藏着最强大的力量。接受诱惑，与腐化融为一体吧。

entries.source: A corruptor is a terrible foe, wielding dark magics that can sap the very soul of her target.
entries.target: 腐化者是一个恐怖的对手，使用黑暗魔法并汲取目标的灵魂。

entries.source: They can harness the blight of evil, crushing souls, stealing life force to replenish themselves.
entries.target: 他们驾驭邪恶的枯萎术，粉碎灵魂，偷取生命力量来治疗自己。

entries.source: The most powerful corruptors can even take on some demonic aspects for themselves.
entries.target: 最强大的腐化者甚至可以掌握恶魔的力量。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Magic and Willpower
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：魔力和意志。

entries.source: Mage
entries.target: 法师系

entries.source: Mages are the wielders of arcane powers, able to cast powerful spells of destruction or to heal their wounds with nothing but a thought.
entries.target: 法师们用奥术魔法来武装自己，只要一闪念就能够释放破坏性的法术或者治疗自己。

entries.source: Golem
entries.target: 傀儡

entries.source: Alchemist
entries.target: 炼金术师

entries.source: An Alchemist is a manipulator of materials using magic.
entries.target: 炼金术士使用魔法来操纵物质。

entries.source: They do not use the forbidden arcane arts practised by the mages of old - such perverters of nature have been shunned or actively hunted down since the Spellblaze.
entries.target: 他们不使用古代法师所施行的被禁止的奥术——自魔法大爆炸以来，这些扭曲自然的人一直被排斥甚至遭到追捕。

entries.source: Alchemists can transmute gems to bring forth elemental effects, turning them into balls of fire, torrents of acid, and other effects.  They can also reinforce armour with magical effects using gems, and channel arcane staffs to produce bolts of energy.
entries.target: 炼金术士可以将元素力量输入各种宝石，使它们变成火球、酸液和其他效果。另外他们也可以利用宝石来强化装甲并使用法杖发射能量球。

entries.source: Though normally physically weak, most alchemists are accompanied by magical golems which they construct and use as bodyguards.  These golems are enslaved to their master's will, and can grow in power as their master advances through the arts.
entries.target: 炼金术士自身非常脆弱，但是他们可以建造炼金傀儡来保护他们。傀儡服从主人的意志，并依靠主人来强化它们的力量。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Magic and Constitution
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：魔力和体质。

entries.target: 傀儡成为龙傀儡

entries.source: Archmage
entries.target: 元素法师

entries.source: Hated, harrowed, hunted, hidden... Our ways are forbidden, but our cause is just. In our veiled valley we find solace from the world's wrath, free to study our arts. Only through charity and friendship can you earn our trust.
entries.target: 憎恨、折磨、追捕、隐藏……我们的道路被禁止，但是我们的事业是正义的。在我们隐藏的山谷里，我们自由地钻研自己的魔法技艺，远离这个世界的怒火，得以安心。只有慈善和友谊才能赢得我们的信任。

entries.source: An Archmage devotes his whole life to the study of magic above anything else.
entries.target: 对一个元素法师来说魔法超越一切，他们倾尽一生学习魔法。

entries.source: Most Archmagi lack basic skills that others take for granted (like general fighting sense), but they make up for it by their raw magical power.
entries.target: 元素法师缺乏最基本的物理格斗技能，他们用魔法取而代之。

entries.source: Archmagi start with knowledge of many schools of magic. However, they usually refuse to have anything to do with Necromancy.
entries.target: 元素法师初始便掌握多个魔法学派的知识。然而，他们通常拒绝与死灵法术有任何关联。

entries.source: Most Archmagi have been trained in the secret town of Angolwen and possess a unique spell to teleport to it directly.
entries.target: 大多数元素法师在一个名叫安格利文的秘密小镇接受训练，并拥有一个直接传送到那里的独特法术。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Magic and Willpower
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：魔力和意志。

entries.source: Necromancer
entries.target: 死灵法师

entries.source: The road to necromancy is a macabre path indeed. Walk with the dead, and drink deeply of their black knowledge.
entries.target: 通往死灵法师的道路是极其可怕的。与死者同行，尽情汲取他们的黑暗知识。

entries.source: While most magic is viewed with suspicion since the Spellblaze, the stigma surrounding the black art of Necromancy has been around since time immemorial.
entries.target: 尽管自从魔法大爆炸以来，大部分魔法受到质疑，但自远古以来，死灵法师的黑暗魔法始终背负着骂名。

entries.source: These dark spellcasters extinguish life, twist death, and raise armies of undead monsters to sate their lust for power and pursue their ultimate goal: Eternal life.
entries.target: 这些黑暗的施法者泯灭生命、扭曲死亡、召唤不死亡灵作为他们的军队来满足他们对力量的渴求，并追求他们的终极目标：永恒的生命。
